description: This is a 3D model of a white chandelier. It features a cylindrical canopy at the top, from which a thin wire suspends a complex, organic-looking cluster of intertwined branches. These branches are curved and twisting, resembling natural forms like coral or vines. Small, leaf-like elements are attached at various points along the branches, suggesting buds or small lights. The overall design is abstract and artistic, creating a sense of movement and natural growth. The model is rendered in a monochromatic white against a plain grey background, highlighting its sculptural form.
